_comment: The apps on /apps, in the order of the page's row of cards (the requestable ones first, Patrik 2026-11-01; the home page's icon stack follows it too); the first is chosen when the page opens. availability: request (a Request access button) or showcase (shown, no button). request: where the button goes, an address per language: the app's own contact page with Get the app chosen (Aresium's on aresium.de, Arestemis's and the Ares Empire's on www.ares-empire.de, 2026-11-01); without it, the Ares Empire's contact page (site.json links.contact). repo: the public GitHub repository with the app's front page (for Arestemis and Aresus, whose servers are private, the iPhone code in empire-ios), else null. demo: a page to try it without an account (Aresium's /demo), else absent. shots: for each look of the site, [front, back] pictures from empire-ios/showcase/<id>/ (import them with tools/import-showcase.py); a look without its own pair uses dark's. Accents are the apps' own (empire-ios Shared/Design: AppAccent; Aresium's red).
